Privacy HopQA training filter viewer

This viewer answers three questions: what fraction of generated actor samples are filtered before training, whether that fraction changes by model version/time, and which chain rows appear to never receive non-zero LOO advantage. Actor advantage is approximate but uses the same grouping convention we currently rely on: prefix-step runs group by group_id + step_index; outcome-level runs group by group_id.
